currentRoundInspection.scope: Exhibition Pavilion, Yad Vashem: an open courtyard-facing L-shaped reconstruction inside the distinct nine-corner mapped range. Preserve the empty court; author the tall blank end wall with a deep entrance, actual stair-window aperture and upper stair notch, plus the curved rising exterior stair wing, solid low concrete guards and planted sloping roof. Keep Art Museum, independent upper plaza, courtyard paving/trees/benches and other campus buildings outside this asset. Internal room arrangements and exhibition displays are not modeled.
